summary: Delivery is a portable pure state machine over a product-issued session/client/token ticket, monotonic revisions and a caller-supplied clock. At queue capacity, publishing replaces pending deltas with the supplied current full snapshot; delayed acknowledgements retain newer messages and ahead-of-authority acknowledgements refuse. Reconnect validates the original ticket and rejects a disconnected ticket after its expiry; dispose clears pending work and makes later operations refuse. This is delivery policy, not token issuance/authentication, socket management, server simulation authority or a gameplay protocol. The cited controls exercise delayed acknowledgements, saturation, reconnect identity/expiry and disposal; source/test presence does not establish installed receiver or real network acceptance.
title: Bounded delivery coalesces overflow into an authoritative snapshot
